verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth's own docs say it supports adding a second factor to sign-in with TOTP (or phone), which covers the core of the MFA requirement. Nothing in the pack shows backup or recovery codes, step-up enforcement, or a way to require MFA for all users. Missing for 10: backup/recovery codes, step-up enforcement for sensitive actions, documented MFA-required policies, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can require multi-factor authentication with TOTP authenticator apps and backup codes, with step-up enforcement where needed

citations.quote: Add a second factor to user sign-in with TOTP or phone.
